paragraphs.text: 76% of dogs show separation anxiety. PawMe stays with them — so you don't have to feel guilty.
847 pet parents already joined the waitlist. Lock in 50% off before we launch.
The AI companion that follows your pet from room to room — so they're never truly alone.
Separation anxiety affects more pets than most owners realize. Here's what the research shows:
76% of dogs display at least one sign of separation anxiety — pacing, whining, destructive behavior — when left alone. Most owners never realize it.
Research shows pets hit peak anxiety within the first 40 minutes of being alone. That's when they need comfort the most — and you can't be there.
Pet owners spend an average of $1,200/year on anxiety-related damage and vet bills. The emotional cost? That's harder to measure.
Answer 4 quick questions and we'll show you exactly how PawMe can help your specific situation.
PawMe is the world's first AI pet companion that follows your pet room to room, responds to their behavior, and gives you real-time peace of mind — wherever you are.
AI-powered navigation moves from room to room, tracking your pet's location so you never stare at an empty frame again.
Machine learning detects anxiety patterns, unusual behavior, and health anomalies — then alerts you before it becomes a problem.
Interactive features let PawMe respond to your pet with calming sounds, treat dispensing, and familiar voice playback.
AI-powered wheels and sensors follow your pet seamlessly between rooms. No blind spots.
Get notified the moment PawMe detects stress signals — pacing, whining, or unusual stillness.
Track sleep, play, and movement patterns. Know exactly how your pet spends their day.
Crystal-clear video with two-way audio. Talk to your pet from anywhere in the world.
Early detection of limping, lethargy, or breathing changes. Your vet will thank you.
